# A model that represents a government's responsibility to ensure certain standards of food quality and safety, and that determines whether certain food products meet the target standards.

The government is responsible for ensuring the quality and safety of food products for the public. They create requirements to ensure that the food is safe and of high quality. Manufacturers and distributors use the requirements and models to determine whether the food meets the standards the government has set. In many jurisdictions, the government also inspects the food products and determines what requirements must be met.
